license_required.quote: Only a person licensed or otherwise authorized to practice under this chapter shall be engaged in dietetic practice

issuing_authority.value: Georgia Board of Examiners of Licensed Dietitians
issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Georgia Board of Examiners of Licensed Dietitians established by this chapter.

type.quote: There is created the Georgia Board of Examiners of Licensed Dietitians.

umbrella_agency.quote: There is created within the office of the Secretary of State the professional licensing boards division

age_minimum.quote: Each applicant for a license as a dietitian shall be at least 18 years of age

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate or higher degree with major in dietetics, human nutrition, food and nutrition, nutrition education, or food systems management
degree_required.quote: Receipt of a baccalaureate or higher degree from a college or university accredited by the Southern Association of Schools and Colleges or any other regional accreditation agency with a major course of study in dietetics, human nutrition, food and nutrition, nutrition education, or food systems management

accrediting_body.value: Southern Association of Schools and Colleges or any other regional accreditation agency
accrediting_body.quote: from a college or university accredited by the Southern Association of Schools and Colleges or any other regional accreditation agency

required.quote: Satisfactory completion of a documented, supervised experience component in dietetic practice of not less than 900 hours supervised by a licensed dietitian or registered dietitian as prescribed by the board

duration.quote: supervised experience component in dietetic practice of not less than 900 hours

kind.value: supervised experience component in dietetic practice
kind.quote: documented, supervised experience component in dietetic practice

exams.name: Dietetics competency examination
exams.notes: May include the Commission on Dietetic Registration examination or any other examination approved by two-thirds vote of the board; may be administered by a national testing service.
exams.jurisdiction: national or state — may be administered by a national testing service
exams.quote: The board shall prescribe or develop the examinations which may include an examination given by the Commission on Dietetic Registration of the American Dietetic Association or any other examination approved by two-thirds' vote of the board.

interval_years.quote: The license shall be renewed biennially if the licensee is not in violation of this chapter at the time of application for renewal

required.quote: if the applicant fulfills current requirements of continuing education as established by the board

available.quote: The board may grant, upon application and payment of proper fees, a license without examination to a person who, at the time of application, either: (1) Holds a valid license as a licensed dietitian issued by another state, political territory, or jurisdiction acceptable to the board if, in the board's opinion, the requirements for that license are substantially equal to or greater than the requirements of this chapter

requirements.value: Holds a valid license as a licensed dietitian issued by another state, political territory, or jurisdiction with requirements substantially equal to or greater than Georgia's requirements; OR presents evidence of registration as a registered dietitian by the Commission on Dietetic Registration of the American Dietetic Association.
requirements.quote: Holds a valid license as a licensed dietitian issued by another state, political territory, or jurisdiction acceptable to the board if, in the board's opinion, the requirements for that license are substantially equal to or greater than the requirements of this chapter; or Presents evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant is registered as a registered dietitian by the Commission on Dietetic Registration of the American Dietetic Association or its successor organization.

exists.quote: There is created the Georgia Board of Examiners of Licensed Dietitians.

national_certification.value: Commission on Dietetic Registration of the American Dietetic Association
national_certification.quote: Presents evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant is registered as a registered dietitian by the Commission on Dietetic Registration of the American Dietetic Association or its successor organization.

national_association.quote: "registered dietitian" means a person registered by the Commission on Dietetic Registration of the American Dietetic Association.

is_mandatory.quote: Only a person licensed or otherwise authorized to practice under this chapter shall be engaged in dietetic practice

title_protection.quote: Only a person licensed or otherwise authorized to practice under this chapter shall be engaged in dietetic practice or use the title "dietitian" or use the letters "LD" or any facsimile thereof or represent himself or herself to the public as a dietitian.

scope_protection.quote: Only a person licensed or otherwise authorized to practice under this chapter shall be engaged in dietetic practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license contained in this Code section or under the laws, rules, or regulations under which licensure is sought or held

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations or practiced fraud or deceit in obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of a business or profession licensed under this title or on any document connected therewith; or practiced fraud or deceit or intentionally made any false statement in obtaining a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of any felony or crime involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude in the courts of this state or any other state, territory, or country or in the courts of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Arrested, charged, and sentenced for a felony or crime involving moral turpitude via nolo contendere, first offender treatment, or withheld adjudication.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been arrested, charged, and sentenced for the commission of any felony, or any crime involving moral turpitude, where: (A) A plea of nolo contendere was entered to the charge; (B) First offender treatment without adjudication of guilt pursuant to the charge was granted; or (C) An adjudication or sentence was otherwise withheld or not entered on the charge.

disciplinary_grounds.description: License revoked, suspended, annulled, or refused renewal by another lawful licensing authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his or her license to practice a business or profession licensed under this title revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing authority other than the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct harmful to the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any unprofessional, immoral, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public, which conduct or practice materially affects the fitness of the licensee or applicant to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aided, assisted, or encouraged an unlicensed person or a licensee with a suspended/revoked license to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly performed any act which in any way aids, assists, procures, advises, or encourages any unlicensed person or any licensee whose license has been suspended or revoked by a professional licensing board to practice a business or profession licensed under this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a statute, law, rule, or regulation related to the profession, or violated a lawful board order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a statute, law, or any rule or regulation of this state, any other state, the professional licensing board regulating the business or profession licensed under this title, the United States, or any other lawful authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction within or outside of this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety by reason of illness, alcohol, drugs, or other substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Displayed an inability to practice a business or profession licensed under this title with reasonable skill and safety to the public or has become unable to practice the licensed business or profession with reasonable skill and safety to the public by reason of illness, use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material.

definition_quote.value: "Dietetic practice" or "dietetics" means the integration and application for compensation of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, management, and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain client health through the provision of nutrition care services
definition_quote.quote: "Dietetic practice" or "dietetics" means the integration and application for compensation of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, management, and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain client health through the provision of nutrition care services

value: Assessing nutritional needs based on biochemical, anthropometric, physical, and dietary data including enteral and parenteral nutrition
Establishing priorities, goals, and objectives to meet nutritional needs
Providing dietetic nutrition counseling
Developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care delivery systems
Evaluating, making changes in, and maintaining standards of quality in food and nutrition care services
methods_authorized.quote: Assessing the nutritional needs of individuals and groups based upon appropriate biochemical, anthropometric, physical, and dietary data to determine nutrient needs and recommend appropriate intake including enteral and parenteral nutrition; Establishing priorities, goals, and objectives which meet nutritional needs; Providing dietetic nutrition counseling; Developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care delivery systems; and Evaluating, making changes in, and maintaining standards of quality in food and nutrition care services.

value: licensed dietitian
provisionally licensed dietitian
license_type_structure.quote: "Dietitian" means a person duly licensed under this chapter to practice dietetics. ... "Provisionally licensed dietitian" means a person provisionally licensed under this chapter.

provisional_license_available.quote: A provisional permit to practice as a provisionally licensed dietitian under the supervision of a dietitian may be issued by the board upon the filing of an application with appropriate fees and submission of evidence of successful completion of a substantial portion of the requirements for licensure

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: The permit shall be issued for one year and may be renewed at the discretion of the board for a length of time determined by the board.

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: A provisional permit to practice as a provisionally licensed dietitian under the supervision of a dietitian may be issued by the board

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: a dietetic technician, certified dietary manager, or dietetic aide in a health care facility from providing nutrition services under the supervision of or in consultation with a dietitian

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: Presents evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant is registered as a registered dietitian by the Commission on Dietetic Registration of the American Dietetic Association or its successor organization.

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: As used in this chapter, the terms "dietetic practice," "dietetics," and "medical nutrition therapy" are interchangeable.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: recommend appropriate intake including enteral and parenteral nutrition

exempt_professions_list.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to affect or prevent: (1) A student enrolled in an approved academic program in dietetics ... (2) A dietitian who is serving in the armed forces ... (3) Persons licensed to practice the professions of dentistry, medicine, osteopathy, chiropractic, nursing, or pharmacy from engaging in the practice of dietetics when incidental to the practice of their profession ... (4) A nonresident registered dietitian ... (7) Persons who provide weight control services ... (8) Persons from marketing or distributing food ...

federal_employee_exemption.quote: A dietitian who is serving in the armed forces of the United States or any other federal agency from engaging in the practice of dietetics, provided that such practice is related to service or employment

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: Persons who provide weight control services, provided the weight control program has been reviewed by, consultation is available from, and no program change can be initiated without the prior approval of either a dietitian licensed under this chapter, a dietitian licensed in another state which has licensure requirements which are substantially equal to the requirements contained in this chapter, or a registered dietitian

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: Persons from marketing or distributing food, disseminating information on food, food materials, dietary or food supplements, or minerals or herbs, including but not limited to operators and employees of health food stores or other licensed businesses which sell such products

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: A nonresident registered dietitian from practicing dietetics in this state for five days without a license or up to 30 days per year with licensure from another state if the requirements for licensure are substantially equal to the requirements contained in this chapter

nonresident_temporary_practice_max_days.quote: up to 30 days per year with licensure from another state if the requirements for licensure are substantially equal to the requirements contained in this chapter
